title: RadGraph-XL: Radiology Entity and Relation Extraction
description: Entity and relation extraction from radiology reports. Annotators identify clinical entities (Anatomy and Observation, each marked definitely present, uncertain, or definitely absent) and label relations between them (located_at, suggestive_of, modify).
